case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests repeatedly praise friendly, helpful staff, a calm, restful location, comfortable rooms with pleasant terraces, a pleasant pool, cleanliness and convenient parking; several reviews also note good or excellent breakfasts and reliable internet. Criticisms include some outdated facilities (shower), limited breakfast options (including lack of espresso), firm/high pillows, charges for pool table and swim caps, an outdoor gym perceived as inconvenient, and no outdoor pool/heat on the terrace.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Replace pillows, inspect/repair shower fittings; audit rooms for cosmetic targets; develop phased refurbishment budget.
Offer espresso or short complimentary espresso, expand buffet where feasible, communicate items, survey guests.

priorities.area: Ancillary charges and guest-facing policies (pool cap, games-room fee)
priorities.recommendation: Immediately review/clarify fees; if hygiene/maintenance, document/communicate; otherwise consider removing/bundling/offering complimentary; track uptake and feedback.
Review breakfast inclusions/communication: confirm espresso/extras, evaluate variety, consider modest changes, update guest materials if unchanged.

priorities.area: Leisure / outdoor amenities (pool, gym, game room, green areas)
priorities.recommendation: Review amenity descriptions/charges; gather outdoor comfort feedback/feasibility; evaluate/consider policies; commission capital assessment if additions considered.
Verify and, if necessary, correct listings, establish validation checklist, and inform guests about amenity locations.
